purpose: Heavy Rebuild clean-master architectural program for a ruined urban electrical utility substation with legible perimeter security, switching yard, transformer, control, cable, and maintenance functions.
architectural_rules: The electrical yard must preserve ordered equipment bays and clearance aisles rather than arbitrary machinery scatter.
Transformer and switchgear positions must connect visually and spatially through plausible buswork or cable-route logic.
The control building must have a controlled relationship to the yard and a clear service route from the perimeter gate.
Perimeter security must define the site without eliminating a deliberate exploration entrance or breach.
Equipment foundations, gantries, poles, and frames must be structurally seated and may not float over terrain.

damage_doctrine.intent: Failed electrical distribution site with localized blast, fire, weather, and abandonment damage while retaining recognizable power-flow organization.
